guidance_specs.target_object: topmost brown paper napkin on the stack inside the perforated silver basket
constraints: Lift the napkin clear of the basket rim before moving left

guidance_specs.context: Separate the top napkin from the stack and basket walls for the robot's single-napkin pickup.

review.problem: The desired sheet lies directly on other napkins inside raised basket walls, which impede the stated single-sheet grasp.
review.rationale: A human can separate one sheet quickly; preparing an isolated pickup avoids taking several napkins together.
review.notes: Task and robot contexts are authored scenario assumptions, not recorded robot observations. All listed photographs were visually reviewed; this example uses only the named input image. The collector confirmed on 2026-10-26 that the original candidate movement distances were measured or deliberately staged. The distance here is reused from that target annotation, not inferred from RGB. Legacy T002, 25 cm relocation. Image 02 is selected because camera-left leads along the broad clear tabletop rather than toward the near-left corner seen in image 01. Only the measured displacement length is reused; direction is grounded in image 02. Lift over the rim rather than drag through it; the composer does not execute collision avoidance.

review.rationale: Separating the pepper shaker provides lateral finger clearance. The overhead approach uses the body above the basket rim, so the basket need not move.
